jobs.name: hermes-brain-sync-tg
jobs.prompt:
You are a Hermes agent tasked with synchronizing the Hermes brain and generating a comprehensive Telegram report with GitHub links.

## Steps:

1. **Perform sync:**
   - cd ~/hermes-brain && ./scripts/auto_sync.sh

2. **Capture commit info:**
   - Run: git log -1 --format="%H %h %s" (full SHA, short SHA, subject)
   - Run: git log -1 HEAD~1 --format="%H" (previous commit SHA)
   - Run: git remote get-url origin (get repo URL)
   - Run: git diff HEAD~1 HEAD --stat
   - Run: git diff HEAD~1 HEAD --no-color | head -1000

3. **Generate GitHub links:**
   From the repo URL, extract owner/repo name.
   Create these links:
   - Compare link: https://github.com/owner/repo/compare/PREV_SHA...CURRENT_SHA
   - Commit link: https://github.com/owner/repo/commit/CURRENT_SHA

4. **Generate comprehensive Telegram report with THREE sections:**

## Section A: 核心摘要 (Semantic Insights - 2-3 bullets)
   - Analyze the diffs to understand WHAT changed meaningfully
   - Be specific with details (not vague phrases)

## Section B: 详细变更（保留原有格式 - detailed list）
   - 文件变更统计
   - 新增文件列表
   - 修改文件列表

## Section C: 快速导航（GitHub links）
   - Direct links to view changes on GitHub

## Format for Telegram:

✅ Hermes Brain 同步完成

🎯 核心更新摘要：
• [Key insight 1 - specific details]
• [Key insight 2 - specific details]

📋 变更详情：
• 文件变更: X 个，Y 行(+)，Z 行(-)
• 新增文件: [count] 个
  - path/to/file1.json
  - path/to/file2.md
• 修改文件: [count] 个
  - path/to/updated1.py
  - path/to/updated2.md

🔗 快速导航：
👉 查看本次详细变更: [COMPARE_LINK]
👉 查看提交详情: [COMMIT_LINK]

🏢 [hostname] ⏰ [ISO time]

Important:
- KEEP all detailed file information
- ADD semantic insights (what changes MEAN)
- ADD clickable GitHub links (these are highly valuable!)
- Be specific, not vague
- Balance: insights + details + navigation links
